old male with abdominal distension"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 60 year old male came to the casualty with the chief complaints of distension of abdomen since 2-3 months, bilateral lower limb swelling since 1 month and dark stools since 4 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently normal 11 years back following which he developed sudden onset of chest pain associated with sweating and diagnosed with ? CAD and had CAG + PTCA and was on regular follow up since then.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;4 months later he had persistent headache and neck pain for which he was taken to the hospital nearby where he was diagnosed with HTN and Diabetes and treated accordingly.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3 months back patient noticed progressive abdominal distension associated with SOB grade 3 for which he consulted the local RMP and got treated but refused to get admitted in hospital as he had to attend his daughter’s marriage in the coming week. Exactly one day after his daughter’s wedding patient had a bout of vomiting with fresh blood as content.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn Tuesday patient came to KIMS - NKP Gastro OPD, endoscopy was done which reveals grade 2-3 esophageal varices then he was immediately referred to KIMS - KHL for banding. Patient got admitted in KHL and banding was done.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EX RAY shows right sided massive effusion for which ICD was placed, large volume paracentesis done, 3L ascitic fluid recovered.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EINJ. Albumin and ocreotide was given.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/c\/o DM and HTN\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/c\/o CAD S\/P PTCA\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history - Consumes mixed diet, appetite lost, regular bowel movements\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESmoking history of 5-6 years and stopped 6 months back\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo significant family history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent and cooperative\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPallor and edema +\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBp 110\/90 mmhg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPr 80bpm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERr 17cpm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpo2 95%@ room air\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGrbs 103 mg\/dl\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECVS - s1 s2 +\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo murmurs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERS - bae + NVBS\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECNS - no FND\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EP\/A - soft, non tender and distended abdomen\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
